high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the verified account "chrishemsworth," taken 12 hours prior to the screenshot being captured. The timestamp at the top of the image shows it was taken at 4:04 PM. The photo features three individuals standing together in front of a decorative backdrop. The backdrop consists of a pink and white striped floor with a pink bench and a green hedge wall adorned with white flowers and greenery. Above the hedge, there is a wooden slatted ceiling. Person on the left: A man with short brown hair and a beard is wearing a navy blue button
